text:
alex: Quick sync on Acme POC capacity + budget. They gave target traffic: 2k requests/hr, average ~800 tokens per request, peak concurrency ~15-20. Need a short runbook and cost/GPU sizing for presales deck.

maria: Got it. Clarify: 2k req/hr steady or ramp? also are requests mostly single-turn chat or multi-turn context?

alex: Mostly single-turn summarization + light context (<=3 turns). They expect a 2-week POC with production-like traffic for 2 days.

sam: Rough calc: tokens/hr = 2000 * 800 = 1.6M tokens/hr. For a 24h day that's ~38.4M tokens/day. For the 2-day load test it's ~77M tokens.

sam: Model candidate: open 33B or 70B chat quantized. Performance: on A100-80GB we expect ~6-10 tokens/ms depending on quant/opt. H100 better but pricier. With conservative 8 tokens/ms, single A100 can do ~8k tokens/sec -> ~28.8M tokens/hr (peak continuous). So traffic could be served by 1-2 A100s for throughput; but need headroom for latency/regen.

chris: For presales slide we should present two options: hosted (pay-as-you-go) vs dedicated reserved. Quick cost sketch (placeholder): hosted inference estimate = $X/token * 38.4M/day -> we should convert to estimated daily cost. For dedicated, 2x A100 reserved for the test window + egress/ops.

maria: Can we pick numbers to make it actionable? Use conservative cost assumptions: hosted $0.30 per 1k tokens (placeholder), dedicated infra run-rate $1.2k/day per A100 (inc infra amortized).

sam: Using those: hosted day = (38.4M tokens / 1k) * $0.30 = 38,400 * 0.30 = $11,520/day. Dedicated: 2 A100s * $1,200 = $2,400/day (plus storage/network). So dedicated looks cheaper for high-volume short run.

jade: Success criteria proposal for POC: 1) functional: >=90% pass on 50 eval prompts (domain-specific), 2) perf: p95 latency <250ms for single-turn, 3) throughput: sustain 2k req/hr for 2h window without errors, 4) cost: POC infra + ops < $30k total.

alex: Nice. Add quality guardrail: 10 quick manual checks on hallucination and 5 edge-case prompts. Also need security Q filled (they asked about data retention and key management).

sam: Runbook bullets: - Eval harness: repo link (internal) + sample prompts (50). - Perf test: run k6 script with shape: steady 2k/hr, 2 spikes to 4k/hr for 15m. - Metrics: token counters, p50/p95 latency, gpu util, OOM events. - Fallback: configure model-variant fallback to 33B if 70B overloaded.

chris: I added a small calc snippet for the deck: ```tokens_per_req = 800
reqs_per_hr = 2000
tokens_per_hr = tokens_per_req * reqs_per_hr = 1.6M
approx_gpus_needed = ceil(tokens_per_hr / 28.8M) -> 1 (but use 2 for headroom)```

maria: Deploy note: request a short Dedicated env for 72 hours (2 A100 reserved) to run the grind + smoke. @deploy-bot can you queue that? :slightly_smiling_face:

deploy-bot: Provision request queued: dedicated-reservation 2xA100 for 72h. ETA: 3h. Requestor: maria.

jade: Timeline: Day 0-2 infra + eval imports, Day 3 run smoke + adjustments, Day 4-5 full 2-day soak, Day 6 analysis + deliverables. Stakeholder demo at Day 7.

alex: Action items: sam -> finalize GPU recommendation & cost numbers by EOD, chris -> add cost slide + two scenario numbers (hosted vs dedicated), maria -> submit deploy request and security Q answers, jade -> prepare eval prompt set.

maria: I'll update the presales doc and share latest numbers in the deck. Will ping when infra is ready.

alex: Thanks all :thumbsup:
